$comment: Composite indexes are DECLARED, DEPLOYED artifacts, capped at 1000 per database.
Saved views are user-authored data with arbitrary filters and sorts (GR-11).
Those two facts do not compose: a user saving a new filter-plus-sort combination
would need an index that a data write cannot create.
Frame's answer, per PRD 01 BP-1a, is that indexes are generated from DECLARED
Blueprint metadata rather than from view shapes: declared-filterable fields go into
a generic equality token array and declared-sortable fields into typed generic slots,
so the index count is O(slots) rather than O(Blueprints x view shapes).
This file therefore stays small and hand-authored only for platform collections.
Per-Blueprint indexes are emitted by the metadata compiler. Do not add an index here
because one saved view needed it — that is the failure mode this design avoids.
